summary: Exifone was pulled from the market in France starting in 1989 because of liver harm [3]. A small computer model, not testing done on people, predicted low risk scores for heart and liver issues [M]. A similar drug, Tolcapone, carries a boxed warning in the United States and was pulled from the European Union and five other countries due to liver harm [4]. One clinical trial involving the drug was stopped early simply because funding ran out [6].
